## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` and `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex` pass
- [ ] Tried it locally (`deploy/local/start-app.sh`), never against live

## Needs the owner's decision?

- [ ] Changes what recruiters see (scores, numbers, wording)
- [ ] Changes who can see or do what (roles, permissions)
- [ ] Sends anything to candidates (WhatsApp, email, calls, follow-ups)
- [ ] Changes stored data or the schema (migration with a dry run included)
- [ ] Changes deploy, workflows or crons
